_incident: AI slopsquatting — hallucinated package name (2024-2025 research)
_disclosure: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.10279 (package hallucination in code-gen LLMs); Socket/Lasso 'slopsquatting' coverage
_note: LLMs frequently invent plausible-but-nonexistent dependency names; attackers pre-register them. Modelled as a package that is NOT in the registry (notFound), so the deterministic provenance signal fires critical. The name is also edit-distance 1 from popular `electron`, so slopsquat fires too — both point at the same real threat (a hallucinated near-miss of a real package). The test asserts provenance is present (contains), not that it is the only signal. This is DepWall's headline threat class.
name: electronn
